title: Gin Weche Mamit
stanzas: Gin weche mamit ma Jakristo owinjo, Kowuotho e piny marachni;Ndalo dong` matin nyaka Ruoth Yesu nobi, Kobiro chungo pinyruodhe.
Liete ka ma koro Jokristo nindoe, Noyawre malach e chieng`no;Ji duto maler ma notho kageno Ruoth, Nochier gi ngima mochwere.
Pogruok ok nobedi kucha e piny manyien, Ji nodag kuro nyaka chieng`;Mowar a tung` piny duto nobedi kuro, Ka gipako Ruoth gi wende.
Wawer "Alleluya" kwadendo Ruoth Yesu; Wabed jo madieri chutho;Kwarito gi kinda nyaka Ruodhwa nobi, Nosidhnwa osimbo maber.
chorus: Obiro, birone ochiegini; Obiro e pinyni kendo;Eka noom jogo duto mohere, Ginidhi kode e polo.
